mentions.name: Jagged Alliance 2-like game in Godot
mentions.description: A Jagged Alliance 2-like tactical video game being built in Godot, slowly progressing with nothing to share yet; the developer invites other frustrated fans who want to work on it to get in touch.
mentions.problem: There hasn't been a good video game since Jagged Alliance 2.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've also been slowly chipping away at a Jagged Alliance 2-like game in Godot. Nothing to share yet but if anyone else is also frustrated that there hasn't been a good video game since Jagged Alliance 2 and you want to work on it reach out to me through the contact in my profile.
mentions.author: beau_g
